name: FileTransfer
summary: Integrates applications by having one produce a file the other consumes, so that neither needs to know anything of the other beyond an agreed format.

roles.name: FileTransfer
roles.summary: The participant that produces or consumes the shared file. What it buys is that the two applications need share no technology at all; what it costs is timeliness, since the receiver learns nothing until a file is written and found.
